pages.text: Your first beans come from the jungle. Breaking $(thing)grass$() or $(thing)ferns$() in a jungle sometimes drops a $(item)Raw Coffee Bean$(): about 1 time in 32.$(br2)Fortune helps. Shears don't drop any.

Beans found in the jungle are always $(#b8860b)Great$(), since the jungle is where coffee grows best.$(br2)Plant a raw bean on grass or dirt to grow a $(l:caffeinecubed:growing/coffee_bush)Coffee Bush$(/l). Raw beans can also go in a composter.
